assistantContext.description: Sets an AI Assistant context tag, or proposes it when a chat is already in progress. With no messages in the target agent's thread the tag is added (a tag with the same key is replaced); otherwise it is shown as a dashed suggestion the user can add or dismiss. Templates resolve against the action's scope (store values plus event data, e.g. a grid row). The tag is a snapshot and is never refreshed.

agent.description: Model id of the agent whose thread the action targets (the agent workflow's name). Defaults to the active agent; an unknown or unavailable agent falls back to the active agent.

open.description: Open the AI Assistant panel, switch it to the target agent and focus the composer. Default false.
